presets.name: ICP Fit Score (0-100)
presets.description: Score how well a company matches your ICP. Number only — easy to sort/filter.
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You are a B2B sales qualification analyst.
CONTEXT: Company: {company}. Website: {website}. City: {city}. Size: {company_size}. Description: {description}.
TASK: Score 0-100 how well this company fits an ICP of mid-market B2B companies that would buy sales-intelligence software. Weight: firmographic fit 40, buying-signal/intent 25, technographic fit 20, trigger events 15.
FORMAT: Output ONLY the integer score (0-100). No words, no symbols.
FALLBACK: If there is not enough data to judge, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

presets.name: Likely Pain Points

presets.prompt:

CONTEXT: Company: {company} ({website}). What they do: {description}. Size: {company_size}.
TASK: Identify the 2 most likely operational pain points this specific company faces, grounded in their business model and size — not generic platitudes.
FORMAT: Two short bullet points, max 12 words each.
FALLBACK: If the profile is too thin to infer real pains, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

presets.name: Personalized Opening Line

TASK: Write ONE personalized opening line for a cold email that references something specific and true about this company. No flattery, no 'I came across your company'.

FALLBACK: If you cannot reference anything specific, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
